author: @Martina_Poraka_Nasa
text:
I always knew they would last, even tho now you can take them out, still, I kind of wanted to have them 20 years ago but not just anything. 
Girls were putting tribal, Chinese letters, some roses and whatnot, I just knew I will feel it.
And it did. I just graduated and went to volunteer on an island and met incredible people. Honoring that feeling I found some local 3 lines folclor type of their birds - symbol of freedom and fertility. 
And I put a small one. 
The second one is getting my scholarship for master in Bosnia, and there I met lots of other great people, but the reason I left home was after something tragic happened.
And my father stood up next to me.
After 6 month living there I wanted to honor that feeling, to never forget even when we fight, that he will always be my side, so I found some Scotish Celtics saying about father and daughter. 
I put that one too with that alphabet,  so nobody understand. 
They are small, can be covered, but I'm still proud of them- of what they represent. 
Even 20 years later.
Then again, it's just small letters and 3 lines forming a bird.
By today's standards it's like they don't even count :)
To me they do. 
I wouldn't put anymore, those were important for me given the meaning.
